ff-shotgun-mastery-chok-1.front: Pattern % at 40 yd: C, IC, M, F?
ff-shotgun-mastery-chok-1.back: About 40, 50, 60, 70 percent in a 76 cm circle (lead shot, a starting point).

ff-shotgun-mastery-chok-3.back: Hard steel pushing on a tight choke, deforming it and possibly locking it in the barrel.

<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>

ff-shotgun-mastery-chok-4.back: Use chokes your maker rates for steel; nothing tighter than modified unless marked steel safe.

ff-shotgun-mastery-chok-5.back: Big sheet at real distance, padded rest, circle densest 76 cm, count and divide, average 5 and look for holes.
